name: Duna Blanca
hero_subtitle: Una duna de arena blanca que se eleva en la laguna — el hito natural más fotografiado de Dakhla.

overview.title: Sand island in turquoise water
overview.p1: The White Dune sits on the lagoon edge about half an hour from town by 4x4 or organised boat. At high tide water wraps its base; at lower water you can walk more of the surrounding flats.
overview.p2: Climb for a full lagoon panorama. Golden hour turns the sand warm against the blue water — the classic Dakhla postcard.
overview.p3: Access is usually via excursion, not a standard rental car. Combine with Dragon Island when agencies offer a joint loop.

q1.question: How do I reach the White Dune?
q1.answer: Organised 4x4 or boat excursion; the track is not ideal for ordinary rental cars.

q2.question: Can I climb it?
q2.answer: Yes, on foot — wear closed shoes and mind the wind on the ridge.

q3.question: Is it free?
q3.answer: The landscape itself has no ticket; you pay for transport or a guided outing.

q4.question: Best time of day?
q4.answer: Late afternoon for colour; check tide if you want water around the base.

q5.question: Combine with Dragon Island?
q5.answer: Often yes on the same half-day or day trip.
